name: Set/toggle a digital output pin
description: Drive an LED or relay on/off, controllable from the dashboard.
setup_guide: Change PIN_NUMBER to match your wiring. This template reads an input variable named `PIN_STATE` — add it under Variables (Type: boolean, Control Type: toggle) so you can switch the pin on/off from the module's settings gear icon on the device page. The module also returns `state` on every run, which you can visualize with a Text Display or Progress Bar.
